basic_details.job_title: HLL Operations Manager (HCD) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: HLL Lifecare Limited, a Government of India enterprise under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, has invited applications for 1 Operations Manager (Mechanical) post in its HCD (Projects & Services – Division), posted at Chandigarh, on an Executive – Fixed Term Contract. The basic pay range is Rs. 30,000 – 50,000 per month. The essential qualification is BE / B.Tech in Mechanical OR Diploma in Engineering (Mechanical), with post-qualification experience. Applications are accepted through a Google Form from 03.11.2026 to 18.11.2026 under Reference Code HLL/HR/106/2026.

how_to_apply: Open the Google Form through the "Click here to Apply" link given in the notice.
Download the prescribed job application form from the link provided in the form or from the HLL website.
Fill in the application form digitally and save it as a PDF or Word file. Handwritten applications will not be accepted.
Upload the completed application form using the file upload option in the Google Form. The maximum size is 10 MB per file.
Attach additional supporting documents in PDF or Word format if required (CV, educational/experience certificates, latest salary slip), each under 10 MB.
Select the correct post applied for in the form, and mention the job title and Reference Code HLL/HR/106/2026 clearly in the application form.
Submit the form on or before 18.11.2026. Late submissions will not be considered.
Completed prescribed application form (PDF or Word)
CV, educational/experience certificates and latest salary slip, if required
SC/ST candidates: SC/ST Caste Certificate in the format applicable for appointment to posts under Government of India
OBC candidates: Other Backward Class (Non-Creamy Layer) Certificate in the format applicable for appointment to posts under Government of India
Candidates working in Government, Semi-Government Organizations, Public Sector Undertakings or Autonomous Bodies: No Objection Certificate (NOC) at the time of the interview
important_instructions: Applications not in the prescribed format will not be considered for the selection process, and no further communication will be sent separately. All information in the application will be verified with original documents at the time of the interview. If any information is found to be false, incorrect or not in conformity with the eligibility criteria, the candidature is liable to be rejected or cancelled at any stage of the recruitment process. HLL reserves the right to cancel, restrict or modify the selection process, or to not fill any or all of the posts notified, at its discretion. The number of vacancies may also be increased or decreased based on organizational requirements. The decision of Management regarding selection will be final. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification.

content_sections.heading: About HLL
content_sections.text: HLL Lifecare Limited is a Government of India enterprise under the administrative control of the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare. According to the notice, it commenced operations on 5 April 1969 and now works across healthcare manufacturing, retail pharmacy, diagnostics, imaging services, healthcare infrastructure development, procurement consultancy, hospital management and other allied services. The notice gives the HLL Group's annual business turnover as approximately ₹6,500 crore.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply. The essential qualification is BE / B.Tech in Mechanical OR Diploma in Engineering (Mechanical). The experience required depends on the qualification held. For both groups, the experience must be post-qualification experience in mechanical engineering, as printed in the notice: Planning, design, development, execution, installation, commissioning, qualification and maintenance of vaccine and biologicals manufacturing facilities, pharmaceutical or biotechnology facilities, similar institutes. Experience in cleanroom HVAC, GMP-compliant utilities and industrial process systems, and in project execution, installation, commissioning and facility maintenance. Knowledge of WHO-GMP, Schedule M, biosafety and contamination control requirements. The notice lists these essential technical competencies: Cleanroom HVAC and controlled environmental systems GMP-compliant process utilities WFI and Purified Water Systems Steam, Pure Steam and Compressed Air Systems Chillers, Boilers and Industrial Utility Systems Biological manufacturing equipment integration Equipment qualification and commissioning Preventive and predictive maintenance Technical tendering, procurement and project management AutoCAD, P&ID and engineering drawing interpretation SC/ST/OBC/PwD candidates are eligible for relaxation as per Government of India directives; the notice does not print the amount of relaxation. The cut-off date for age is the same as the cut-off date for calculating qualification and post-qualification experience. For the full eligibility conditions, candidates should refer to the official notification.

content_sections.heading: HLL Operations Manager (Mechanical) Job Description
content_sections.text: Facility Development & Project Execution: Review designs, specifications, BOQs and P&IDs; supervise mechanical installation, testing and commissioning; coordinate with EPC contractors, consultants and vendors; monitor progress, quality, cost and timelines. HVAC & Cleanroom Engineering: Review and execute HVAC for classified areas, covering HEPA filtration, air changes, pressure cascades and environmental control; coordinate testing, commissioning and qualification. Process Utilities: Supervise installation, commissioning and maintenance of chillers, cooling towers, AHUs, steam and pure steam, WFI, purified water, compressed air and gases, boilers, ETP, exhaust systems and cold storage. Equipment Integration: Coordinate mechanical and utility requirements for bioreactors, fermenters, purification systems and filling lines; ensure hygienic design and maintainability; support qualification documentation. Maintenance & Facility Operations: Develop preventive, predictive and corrective maintenance programmes; ensure utility availability; maintain equipment records and asset plans; implement AMC/CAMC; coordinate calibration and statutory compliance; support deviations, change control and CAPA. GMP, Qualification & Compliance: Ensure compliance with WHO-GMP, Schedule M, biosafety and contamination control; support DQ, IQ, OQ and PQ; coordinate with QA, QC, Validation and Production; support inspections and audits. Tendering & Contract Management: Prepare specifications, BOQs, DPRs, estimates and tender documents; evaluate bids and vendors; monitor contractor performance and handover of completed facilities.
